title: Hogland hotplug golden flag must be threaded through context -> SandboxConfig -> HoglandSandbox.create
answers: How does the tasks-hogland-hotplug-golden flag reach the sandbox?
Add a new per-run hogland sandbox option from a feature flag
Where is the pluggable memory golden snapshot alias selected?
body:
A per-run hogland option resolved from an org feature flag touches these together:
- constant `HOGLAND_HOTPLUG_GOLDEN_FEATURE_FLAG` in products/tasks/backend/constants.py
- `TaskProcessingContext.use_hogland_hotplug_golden` and its resolution in `get_task_processing_context` (products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/activities/get_task_processing_context.py); evaluated only when sandbox_backend == "hogland", org-scoped groups, wrapped in try/except so it fails closed to False
- `_create_sandbox_for_repository` passes `use_hotplug_golden=ctx.use_hogland_hotplug_golden` (products/tasks/backend/temporal/process_task/activities/provision_sandbox.py)
- `SandboxConfig.use_hotplug_golden` (products/tasks/backend/logic/services/sandbox.py)
- `HoglandSandbox.create` swaps to `HOGLAND_HOTPLUG_SNAPSHOT_ALIAS` (products/tasks/backend/logic/services/hogland_sandbox.py), only for `SandboxTemplate.DEFAULT_BASE`
New context fields need a default (False) so in-flight Temporal runs deserialize safely. Test: `TestHoglandSandboxCreate.test_create_selects_the_golden_by_hotplug_flag`.
